Robert Simmons

Republican candidate for United States Senator, District of Columbia · Challenger

Robert "Rob" Simmons is the Republican nominee for U.S. Shadow Senator from the District of Columbia in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Paul Strauss. The D.C. Board of Elections lists him as a Republican candidate for the office. In 2024 he was the Republican candidate for an at-large seat on the D.C. Council.

Where Simmons stands

D.C. congressional representation
Says he would push for congressional representation for D.C. while bringing a Republican perspective to the shadow delegation.
Campaign priorities
His campaign focuses on public safety, fiscal accountability and cooperation with the federal government.

Background

  • Republican candidate, D.C. Council at-large, 2024 (not elected; 6.32% of the vote)
  • Republican nominee, U.S. Shadow Senator (D.C.), 2026
